description:
Tatz'eta chi saq ri usamaj.

Tikirisaj ruk' ri nuk'ulem katraj katijtob'ej. LumaTrace nucholajij ri jun chik q'at, ri etab'alil man k'o ta kewa' N/A.

Windows: Cha' jun app o etz'anem process pa we PC, k'a te ri' tikirisaj ri etab'al. We nitz'apix ri process, niq'at ri session o nitz'ib'ax jun q'alaj q'atoj.

Android: Pa ri oyonib'al tikirisaj Developer options xuquje' USB debugging, ya' q'ij che ri PC, jaq ri app katraj katijtob'ej, k'a te ri' pitz'a Tikirisaj ri etab'al. LumaTrace nretamaj pa rib'il rib' ri package k'o chuwäch.

Cha' jun xk'ulmatajik rech katz'eta FPS, 1% low, frame time, CPU, memory xuquje' ri taq utzijoxik elesam.

Android nukol jun ch'ajch'ojirisam ADB logcat pa ri ramaj etab'al. Windows nukol taq LumaTrace session record ruk' retab'al ramaj.

Ri rajil man k'o ta kewa' N/A, man kenojisax ta ruk' 0.

Man netaq pa cloud ta
